title: VN1 Forecasting – Accuracy Challenge
description:
Weekly sales and prices of 15,053 product-warehouse combinations from 46 e-vendors, from July 2020 to April 2024, from the VN1 forecasting competition of 2024. With the official scoring code, the two benchmarks and the five winning forecasts.

Organized by Nicolas Vandeput (SupChains). Data provided by Flieber. Sponsored by Flieber, Syrup and SupChains. Page and results: https://supchains.com/vn1-forecasting-competition/
notes: If you use the data or the code of VN1, please cite the competition: Vandeput, N. (2024). VN1 Forecasting – Accuracy Challenge. Organized by Nicolas Vandeput (SupChains). Data provided by Flieber. Sponsored by Flieber, Syrup and SupChains. https://supchains.com/vn1-forecasting-competition/
